set.body: Implement user review items 1–3 in the existing VoyageLowering and VoyageView. Reuse current compiler, marks, origins, group-level spans, external-dominant hollows, inspector and receipts. Default live ghosts to selected units; retain explicit all-ghost opt-in. Use neutral source group bands, 180px-plus label gutter, full wrapped numbered labels at actual group midpoints, deterministic density-prioritized collision policy with selected group priority. Build legend from visible mark types and controls; no coding/absence/untimed entries when absent. Correct raw-posterior and speech-duration wording without inventing missing policy metadata. This explicitly declared Voyage presentation revision changes static/live layout and SVG hashes; preserve all scientific receipt fields and textual twins. Retain baseline evidence for comparison. Codex/Atlas presets are unchanged; no duplicate legacy renderer. Acceptance: synthetic default/selected/all ghost tests, coding-present/absent and selected short-group label cases, unchanged mark identities/masses, actual NN03 counts 173/108/44/35/0, real desktop/compact screenshots and applicable compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS plus shell smoke. Rollback: restore prior live display choices; never modify input artifacts. Brush/detail, mass strip, full inspector redesign and arm comparison remain separate tracked slices. No Intaglio defect identified; file in that repo if renderer limitations are verified.
